files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- Sessions table: the comment column takes the remaining width instead of being squeezed under the action buttons; long comments are limited to three lines (full text on hover and in the session form).
- Sessions table: equipment and buddies are listed one per line, and the column filters no longer widen their columns.
